WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), shares AS (
  SELECT order_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(b.order_count) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share), 0) AS total_count,
  AVG(s.share) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.share - s.average_share) FILTER (WHERE s.share > s.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM bucket_counts AS b
JOIN scored AS s ON s.share = b.order_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM bucket_counts), 0);

assumptions.assumption: A NULL timespan is the bucket for orders with no time in force; SQL GROUP BY places all such orders in one bucket.
